always_load_config.description: Whether to load config for slave instances (0/1)

anonymous.description: Whether to run in anonymous mode, disabling local file browsing and modifications (0/1)

auto_submit.description: Whether to automatically submit the first form on page load (0/1)

bind_address.description: Local IPv4 address to bind to for outgoing connections

bind_address_ipv6.description: Local IPv6 address to bind to for outgoing connections

local_port.description: Local port to bind to for outgoing connections (0 = auto)

localhost.description: Whether to restrict connections to localhost only (127.0.0.0/8) (0/1)

default_mime_type.description: Default MIME type for unknown documents

proxies.description: List of proxy definitions; each entry defines proxy for a protocol type (http/https/ftp). Must be flat objects with 'type' and optional 'url'.

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated glob patterns of hosts that should bypass proxy

cookie_accept.description: Whether to accept cookies over HTTPS

search_engines.description: List of search engine definitions; each entry has 'name' (required) and 'url' (required).

default_search_engine.description: Name of the default search engine

connection_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network operations

enable_ecmascript.description: Whether to enable JavaScript (requires QuickJS support at compile time)
